# SCI-PTC v0.1/r0.5 Change Log

Date: `2026-08-23`

Comparison baseline: frozen SCI-PTC v0.1/r0.4 at consolidation commit
`55efd8a54464636a24e621f6d1b60486d235b20e`.

- Made the complete affine application operator primary and defined total
  removed signal by input-output identity.
- Separated learned additive location, correlated-subspace removal, and total
  removal while preserving nonrestoring centering.
- Replaced the incomplete named-use eligibility pair with a total T/F/U/C
  decision rule and preserved exact causes and conflicts.
- Kept learning, application, retention, QC, response, and other permissions
  as distinct scientific propositions while allowing shared machinery.
- Preserved upstream classifications such as `engineering-only` without
  globally prohibiting PTC mathematics or requiring a separate route.
- Reserved `mathcal C` for causes and `mathcal M_cand` for candidate-model
  specifications.
- Defined PTC-disabled as complete RTC publication followed by successful
  termination before CAL, PTC, or MAP; no disabled-route map or inferred
  CAL-to-MAP fallback exists.
- Selected exactly one configured array- or network-level PCA grouping with
  group-local support, masks, state, application, and kernel response.
- Required explicit integer rank `k >= 1` independently feasible per group;
  zero and unrealizable rank fail closed without clipping or route conversion.
- Selected one immutable-CAL-parent fit per group, zero support-changing
  refinement, advisory diagnostics, inert conditioned `r`, and exact
  fixed-state kernel propagation.
- Defined ordinary detector centering as the support-normalized arithmetic
  mean over finite basis-fit-admitted occurrences in one immutable segment,
  with binary influence and fail-closed invalid support.
- Added the finite time-local full-rank guard to the mask-aware detector-right
  PCA application. A deficient group-time is unavailable for data and kernel;
  no partial-rank, interpolation, numerical-zero, or cross-group fallback is
  authorized.
- Added Definitions 042--045, Assumptions 030--035, Requirements 090--099,
  and Predictions 051--060 while preserving all earlier stable identifiers.

The frozen inventory is 45 definitions, 25 numbered equations, 35
assumptions, 99 requirements, 60 predictions, and 159 exact crosswalk rows.

No implementation, validation, performance, science-qualification,
production-readiness, audit-finding closure, or MAP claim is made.
